name: FlickDirect Movie MCP Server
tagline: Movie MCP server for facts, news, reviews, podcasts and videos, with original source links.
description: FlickDirect Inc’s free, read-only movie MCP server provides movie and TV facts, available country-specific dates/ratings, trivia, brief quote excerpts, news, reviews, interviews and eligible stored transcripts. Live service 1.5.9 supports recent uploads from three published YouTube channels and bounded FlickRadio archive discovery. Healthy video-feed results remain available if another channel times out, with incomplete coverage reported. Streaming, soundtrack/player and app destinations retain their supplied parameters; Connect does not perform checkout. Retailer listings and daily deals are no longer supported. Bounded longer-title fallback preserves original title words and requested year/media filters. Responses provide bounded source information and original page links, not full articles/reviews/transcripts or photographs. The advertised tools are search_flickdirect_content and get_flickdirect_movie_details. Cached search_fdmd and get_fdmd_movie calls remain compatible at the same endpoint. No FlickDirect account or API key is required; host application requirements and tool selection still apply.

install.notes: Uses Streamable HTTP without authentication. Ask for a title and release year to distinguish similarly named films. Follow and cite FlickDirect source links. The linked repository contains public plugin metadata and setup guidance, not the proprietary service implementation.
